series: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry Predictions; IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2015 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Read from the IDC report PDF (October 2014, IDC #252235) hosted by a third party. IDC calls the ten items 'decision imperatives', not predictions; each has a label (kept in idc_label) and a 'By 20XX, X% ...' statement.

entries.quote: By 2017, 80% of the CIO's Time Will Be Focused on Analytics, Cybersecurity, and Creating New Revenue Streams Through Digital Services
entries.subject: CIO time on analytics, cybersecurity and digital revenue
entries.metric: share of CIO time focused on analytics, cybersecurity and new digital revenue streams

entries.quote: By 2016, 65% of Global Competitive Strategies Will Require Real-Time 3rd Platform IT as a Service
entries.subject: Real-time IT as a service
entries.metric: share of global competitive strategies requiring real-time 3rd Platform ITaaS

entries.quote: By 2016, Security Will Be a Top 3 Business Priority for 70% of CEOs of Global Enterprises
entries.subject: Security as CEO priority
entries.metric: share of CEOs of global enterprises with security as a top 3 business priority

entries.quote: By 2015, 60% of CIOs Will Use DevOps as Their Primary Tool to Address the Speed and Sprawl of Mobile, Cloud, and Open Source Applications
entries.subject: DevOps
entries.metric: share of CIOs using DevOps as primary tool

entries.quote: By 2016, 80% of CIOs Will Deliver a New Architectural Framework That Enables Innovation and Improved Business Decision Making
entries.subject: Architectural framework
entries.metric: share of CIOs delivering a new architectural framework

entries.quote: By 2020, 60% of CIOs in Global Organizations Will Be Supplanted by the Chief Digital Officer for Delivery of IT-Enabled Products and Digital Services
entries.subject: Chief Digital Officer
entries.metric: share of CIOs in global organizations supplanted by the CDO for IT-enabled products and digital services

entries.quote: By 2016, 80% of CIOs Will Accelerate 3rd Platform Migration to Counter Premature Obsolescence of Current IT Assets
entries.subject: Premature obsolescence of IT assets
entries.metric: share of CIOs accelerating 3rd Platform migration

entries.quote: By 2018, 30% of CIOs of Global Organizations Will Have Rolled Out a Pan-Enterprise Data and Analytics Strategy
entries.subject: Pan-enterprise data strategy
entries.metric: share of CIOs of global organizations with a pan-enterprise data and analytics strategy

entries.quote: By 2017, 35% of Vendor Sourcing Relationships Around 3rd Platform Technologies Will Fail, Causing CIOs to Roll Out New Sourcing Processes
entries.subject: 3rd Platform sourcing failures
entries.metric: share of 3rd Platform vendor sourcing relationships that fail

entries.quote: By 2018, 50% of CIOs Will Relinquish IT's Traditional Mode of Technology Control in Favor of an Open Standards–Based Framework
entries.subject: Open standards ecosystem
entries.metric: share of CIOs relinquishing traditional technology control for an open standards framework

notes: IDC's flagship IT industry predictions this year were 'IDC Predictions 2015: Accelerating Innovation — and Growth — on the 3rd Platform' (December 2014, IDC #252700), not a FutureScape. That document has ten topic headings with many sub-predictions each and is not captured (see INDEX.md).
